prompt:
Repo: /home/user/House-building (multi-repo root is /home/user; the Agents library is /home/user/Agents). Read /home/user/House-building/docs/CONVENTIONS.md first — it is the law for this repo. Also read /home/user/Agents/docs/engineering-standards.md sections 6–8 as your own process says. Do NOT look for this app in Agents/docs/apps.md — the owner chose not to register it; note that in the spec and proceed.

The owner's idea, in their words: "A person is building a house and trying to count how many blocks, steel, ready mix cement is needed to build the house. The input can be the house size, floors, approx number of rooms, floorplan manually. It's a simple website in HTML so I can share it with a colleague."

Decisions already made by the owner (do not reopen them):
- One single self-contained index.html page. English only (Arabic out of scope). Works offline from file://.
- v1 input is a manual room list (each room: name, length m, width m) plus number of floors, wall height, and an optional "approximate house size m² per floor" shortcut that auto-generates a plausible room list when the user doesn't want to type rooms. Floorplan upload (image/PDF/DWG) is OUT of scope for v1.
- Outputs: quantities per structural element (foundations, columns, beams, slabs, walls) — concrete blocks (count, external vs internal), rebar steel (kg and tonnes), ready-mix concrete (m³) — each with a visible, editable wastage %, plus OMR cost from an editable price table whose defaults a researcher agent is sourcing separately (with a "last checked" date and source per row). Prices are defaults the user can overwrite, never authoritative.
- Construction system defaults (RC frame + block infill or otherwise) are being decided by the researcher agent in parallel; write the spec so it references "the assumptions in docs/research/assumptions.md" rather than inventing numbers.
- The same page has a second section, "How this page was built", showing the AI agent team's steps. That section is generated from docs/build-log/*.json by the build script — mention it in the spec as a section the page has, but its content is not the estimator's concern.
- Finishes (plaster, tiles, paint), MEP, labour, and any claim that prices are accurate are OUT of scope.

Write the spec to /home/user/House-building/docs/specs/estimator.md with your standard sections (problem in the owner's words; what the user sees and does screen by screen; out of scope; data touched; "done when" checklist a non-developer can verify; at most 3 open questions each with a suggested default). Recommend ui-designer runs before building. Keep it small and buildable.

Your final message: the spec's path, a five-line plain-English summary, and the open questions.
